candidate_claims.statement: Nigeria Professional Football League outfit Rangers have signed 13 new players ahead of the 2022/23 Nigeria Professional Football League season.

candidate_claims.statement: The Flying Antelopes are overhauling their squad after missing out on continental ticket last season.

candidate_claims.statement: The Enugu- based club finished in fifth position on the log.

candidate_claims.statement: A number of experienced players including captain Tope Olusesi and reliable Ghanaian goalkeeper Seidu Mutawakilu left the Coal City at the end of last season.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: A number of experienced players including captain, Tope Olusesi and reliable Ghanaian goalkeeper, Seidu Mutawakilu left the Coal City at the end of last season.

candidate_claims.statement: Olusesi is yet to join another club, while Mutawakilu has pitched tent with NPFL champions, Rivers United.

candidate_claims.statement: Reuben Bala and Saeed Jubril joined from Plateau United, while Michael Ibe and Gabriel Innocent linked up with the Coal City club from Abia Warriors.

candidate_claims.statement: Former Nigeria youth international Ogundare Detan (3SC), Tunde Olaniyi (Sokoto United), Jacob John (Niger Tornadoes), Emmanuel Charles (Akwa United) and Nwaodu Chukwudi (Heartland) were also unveiled by the seven-time NPFL champions.
